caption:
PART 1/2 — The night an empty tanker hit New Orleans twice. 🚢⚠️

2 Feb 2016: the 817-ft Aframax tanker Nordbay, in ballast, heads down the Mississippi in high water with a strong current behind her and wind on her beam. At Nine-Mile Point she can't make the turn — and strikes a barge dock and the city's water intakes. And the night isn't over…

Part 2 tomorrow. Follow so you don't miss it.

Source: NTSB Marine Accident Brief MAB-17/30 (public report). Photos and maps: NTSB report (credits on screen). Animated illustration, not a reconstruction.

#marineaccident #shipping #tanker #mississippiriver #neworleans #seafarer #merchantnavy #marineengineering #NTSB #maritime #shipping_news #jaimarineshorts

scenes.narration: Ten o'clock at night. The Mississippi is in flood, racing towards the sea. You are on the bridge of an empty, eight-hundred-foot tanker... and in eight minutes, she is going to hit New Orleans.
scenes.direction: Low and slow. Like telling a ghost story. Lean hard on 'eight minutes'.

scenes.narration: Twenty-two twelve. The engine suddenly groans. The revs fall. A shudder runs through the whole hull... and then... the bridge alarms scream!
scenes.direction: Start almost in a whisper. Get faster. Shout 'scream!'

scenes.headline: Meet the [Nordbay].
scenes.sub: 817-ft Aframax tanker · in ballast · 24 on board

p.credit: Photo: Reederei Nord Group, via NTSB report

scenes.narration: Rewind three hours. A river pilot climbs aboard the tanker Nordbay. Eight hundred and seventeen feet of steel. No cargo at all. Only ballast.
scenes.direction: Calm, steady, a storyteller setting the scene.

scenes.headline: An empty ship is a [giant sail].
scenes.narration: And an empty ship... is a giant sail. Her deck towers forty-four feet above the water, higher than her draft below. And tonight, a southerly wind is gusting up to twenty-four knots, right onto her beam.
scenes.direction: Slow on 'giant sail'. Build up through the wind.

scenes.headline: The river is [running high].
scenes.narration: The river is running high. Four, five knots of current, shoving her from behind, adding speed she does not want.

scenes.headline: [22:05] Huey P. Long Bridge.
scenes.narration: Twenty-two oh five. Under the Huey P. Long Bridge, at almost fifteen knots over the ground. And dead ahead... Nine-Mile Point. A turn of one hundred and thirty-five degrees.
scenes.direction: Fast, then stop dead before 'Nine-Mile Point'.

scenes.headline: More power... [is it enough?]
scenes.narration: The pilot asks... do we have any more R P M? Eighty-two. Eighty-nine. The engine roars. She swings to starboard... but is it enough?
scenes.direction: Quote the pilot quietly. Count the rpm up. Leave the last question hanging.

scenes.headline: Turning... but [sliding wide].

p.credit: NTSB report · AIS track: mrtis.com · Google Earth

scenes.narration: She is turning... but sliding. Sliding wide. Less than six hundred feet from the bank. Closer. Closer. Twenty-two ten. The danger signal blasts out. Five short blasts.
scenes.direction: Get faster and tighter with every 'closer'. Hit 'five short blasts' hard.

scenes.headline: [22:13] First allision.
scenes.sub: What was left of the barge dock

p.credit: Photo: Infinity Engineering Consultants, via NTSB report

scenes.narration: Twenty-two thirteen. Impact! Steel tears into a barge dock. Mooring dolphins smash apart. The city's water intakes take the hit.

scenes.headline: General alarm. [Hull breached.]

items: General alarm — crew to muster stations

scenes.narration: The general alarm screams through every deck. Crew run to their muster stations. Ballast tank number six is holed... and water is spraying out.
scenes.direction: Urgent, breathless. Drop low on the last line.

lines: 53 minutes later... the master was [on the phone].

scenes.narration: Everyone thinks the nightmare is over. It is not. In fifty-three minutes... Nordbay will hit New Orleans again. And this time... the master is on the phone. Part two, tomorrow. Follow, so you don't miss it.
scenes.direction: Slow and quiet, almost a whisper on 'It is not.' Normal voice for the last line.

cover_title: EMPTY TANKER HITS NEW ORLEANS TWICE
